purpose_context: This mission adds a manifest-runner-shaped muster adapter (src/adapters/spec-kitty-profile/) that statically validates Spec Kitty agent-profile YAML files against the upstream schema and muster-authored cross-profile lints (handoff-graph, doctrine-reference resolution, context-sources integrity, profile-id filename legality, projection-drift vs the agent_profiles_manifest), and ships three rubric documents under docs/rubric/ that this mission and the downstream M4 behavioral-axes mission both cite. It is deliberately not SpecAdapter-implementing (D1), following the memory-utilization adapter's manifest-runner shape.
purpose_tldr: Static conformance adapter for Spec Kitty agent-profile YAML (*.agent.yaml) plus the rubric surface M4 depends on.
source_description: GitHub issue garrison-hq/muster#58 ([M2] spec-kitty-profile-adapter): static agent-profile adapter (src/adapters/spec-kitty-profile/) validating *.agent.yaml against the upstream schema plus muster-authored cross-profile lints (handoff-graph, doctrine-reference resolution, context-sources integrity, profile-id filename legality, projection drift vs .kittify/agent_profiles_manifest.json), and three docs/rubric/ documents (profile taxonomy, behavioral axes for M4, sop-rule-taxonomy v1.1 appendix). Manifest-runner shaped per D1 -- deliberately does not implement SpecAdapter.
